arms.better: The run stopped before an agent turn because the scratch configuration pointed coder.fast at unregistered provider devpass. The error text was unusually actionable: it named the role, providers.toml, and `tm provider list`, and warned that an identical retry would fail. Make the first-run path more guided by offering an explicit provider/candidate repair route (or selecting an available configured candidate) before ticket execution, and surface a concise blocked-run summary in tm events/stats so users can distinguish zero-work setup failure from an agent failure. The hidden stream suite timed out and the browser suite exited nonzero; neither is evidence of a working fix.

OpenCode found source/utils/body.ts and the existing stream tests quickly, made the flush change, and added a regression test. It recovered from a first test design that hung, then reported the targeted test and lint as passing and accurately disclosed the unrelated full-test lint failure. After merged tests were checked out, all 19 stream tests passed and the Chromium empty-body browser test passed; Firefox/WebKit cases could not launch because those Playwright browsers are not installed. Reduce the exploratory test-edit/retry cycle and make the final verification summary distinguish targeted passes from the unavailable browser engines and pnpm's ignored-build failure more explicitly.
